brief:
Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar said in a weekend interview that he expected Israeli politicians to campaign using Gaza's "blood," according to Middle East Eye. Sinwar dismissed the possibility of political change resulting from Israel's upcoming election, suggesting that regardless of which party prevails, the conflict would remain central to campaigning.

The comments reflect Hamas's view that the Gaza war has become a fixture of Israeli electoral politics rather than a catalyst for policy shifts toward Palestinians.
dek: Hamas leader says Israel to use Gaza 'blood' in election The leader of Hamas brushed aside the possibility of change from Israel's upcoming election in an interview on Saturday, saying he expected Israelis to campaign off Gaza's "blood".
title: Hamas leader says Israel will exploit Gaza war in election campaign
